about.title: El Segundo Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a traffic collision upends everything, and in a small, close-knit city like El Segundo, the loss is felt widely. Los Angeles County crash data shows traffic deaths do happen here, even amid the city's relatively low collision numbers, often along corridors like Imperial Highway and Douglas Street where commuter and cross-town traffic mixes. California law gives surviving spouses, domestic partners, and children the first right to bring a wrongful death claim, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain situations. These cases are separate from any criminal charges that may follow a fatal crash, and they exist to help families recover losses tied to the death, not to punish. If you've lost someone in El Segundo, LawProactive can connect you with an independent attorney who can walk you through your options at no upfront cost. You focus on your family; let someone else handle the legal groundwork.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney About a Wrongful Death Claim

items.title: Standing Rules Matter
items.desc: California limits who can file a wrongful death claim, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, then extending to certain other dependents or heirs. An attorney can clarify where your family fits before any deadline passes.

items.title: The Clock Is Running
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, though claims against a government entity carry a much shorter window. Waiting too long can close off options entirely.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond Medical Bills
items.desc: California law allows recovery for funeral costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance, not just economic damages. An attorney can help document these losses accurately.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Generally, a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have the first right to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may be eligible depending on the circumstances. An attorney can review your family's situation to confirm standing.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim connected to a criminal case?
items.answer: No, a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action, even if criminal charges are filed against the driver involved. The two proceedings have different purposes and different outcomes, and one does not depend on the other.

items.question: Does El Segundo see many fatal crashes?
items.answer: Recent public records show 2 traffic deaths in the city's most recent final crash year, alongside 85 injury collisions on roads like Pacific Coast Highway and Sepulveda Boulevard. Every death represents a family facing real loss, and legal support is available regardless of how the crash occurred.
